source_locator: R2225: ch. VII, Reinforcement by the 182d Infantry
current_activity: landing at Lunga Point as a regimental combat team, less 3rd Battalion
notes: Miller, ch. VII: Turner’s transports anchored off Lunga Point at 0530 on 12 November 1942 and landed the 182nd Regimental Combat Team, made up of the 1st and 2nd Battalions, 182nd Infantry, the 245th Field Artillery Battalion, and supporting troops (3,358 men). The 3rd Battalion was still in the New Hebrides. The caption dates the landing to 12 November. All about 6,000 troops on the ships debarked before the transports withdrew that evening. Confidence 0.5: Miller only in this increment.
